title: Config
description: Settings of `botica lint`: `botica.toml`, or the `[tool.botica]` table of `pyproject.toml`.

baseline.description:
The file of known findings, from the root of the project, that `botica lint
--write-baseline` writes. A finding it lists is left out while its value does not grow.

code-dirs.description:
Where the code of the project lives, as directories from its root grouped by ecosystem
(`python`, `js`, `rust`, `go`, `jvm`), for the rules about layout. When absent they are
detected; an empty table says there are none.

extend-exclude.description: Globs of paths to skip, in addition to what `.gitignore` already skips.

extend-include.description:
Globs of paths to lint although `.gitignore` or the list of directories of tools (`.venv`,
`.mypy_cache`…) would leave them out. `extend-exclude` wins over it.

external.description: Globs of rule IDs that suppressions may name without a warning even when they are unknown.

ignore.description: Rules to switch off. Same syntax as `select`.

languages.description: Restrict the run to these languages (empty means every language).

preview.description: Also run the rules whose status is `preview`.

replace.description: Rule to replace -> rule that replaces it.

review.description:
Who reviews a change and how much: areas of the code, roles and classifier (ADR 0017 and
ADR 0018).

rule-dirs.description: Directories with the project's own rules.

rules.description: Settings per rule, keyed by slug, code or alias.

select.description: Rules to run: `default`, `all`, a family (`BTSTRUC`), a code prefix (`BTSTRUC0`), a code, a slug or `tag:<tag>`.

AreaName.description: The four areas of ADR 0018, each with a floor under which no entry can put its tier.

CatalogSource.description: A catalog of rules that lives on disk.

path.description: Directory of the catalog, relative to the directory of this file.

ClassifierConfig.description: Settings of the classifier that runs after the checks (ADR 0018 decisions 6 and 8).

impact-min.description:
`U`: the probability that a mistake shows first to the team or to whoever develops the
repository, at least. Not under 0.7.

max-changed-lines.description: Larger changes go to a person. At most 1000.

min-confidence.description: A `choice` answer with less confidence than this goes to a person. Not under 0.7.

question-max.description: `u`: a question answers `true` with a probability under this one. At most 0.3.

required-checks.description:
The checks that must be present and green. An empty list sends every pull request to a
person.

ClassifierMode.description: What the classifier does with its decision (ADR 0018 decision 13).

oneOf.description: Decides and writes the report, and never merges.

python.description:
The Python of the scripts of the runtime `python`: `project` (the version of
`.python-version`, of `.venv` or of `requires-python`, else 3.13), `system` (a Python of
the system) or a version for uv, as `3.12`. A free-threaded Python is refused.

timeout.description: Seconds that a process has to answer each request. `BOTICA_EXTENSION_TIMEOUT` wins over it.

HistoryConfig.description: Settings of the history of findings in `.botica/history/` (ADR 0019).

record.description:
Each run of `botica lint` appends its findings and the rules it evaluated to
`.botica/history/`, as `--record` does. `--no-record` turns it off for one run.

require-key.description:
A run with no `BOTICA_HISTORY_KEY` records nothing, so that a job where the secret is
missing writes no unkeyed fingerprints.

OnTimeout.description: What `botica lint` does when the process of an extension rule does not answer in time.

oneOf.description: The run fails with exit code 2.
A warning on stderr; the run goes on without the findings of that rule.

Override.description: Changes for the files that match `files`, applied in order.

ParamValue.description: The value of a parameter of a recipe: a string, or a whole number such as a number of days.

installed.description:
Ids of the recipes that the project installed, which `botica recipe install` writes in a
new `botica.toml`. `recipe-conflict` resolves them with the recipes of `recipes/`.

params.description:
The values of the parameters of the recipes, by name: what their templates write in place
of the default. `botica recipe install --set <name>=<value>` takes over for one run.

replace.description:
Ids of the built-in recipes that a recipe of `recipes/` replaces. A recipe of the project
with the id of a built-in one is an error unless the id is listed here.

Ids of the built-in topics that a topic of `references/` replaces. A topic of the project
with the id of a built-in one is an error unless the id is listed here.

ReviewArea.description: One entry of `[[review.areas]]`. An area name may appear in several entries.

approvals.description: The approvals that the paths ask for. Default: 1, and 0 for `periphery`.

owners.description: The people or teams that answer for the paths. Required for `critical` and `platform`.

paths.description: Globs of the paths of the area, as in `applies.paths` of a `REVIEW.md`. At least one.

tier.description: Default: the floor of the area. A lower tier than the floor is an error.

ReviewConfig.description: The `review` table: areas, roles and classifier (ADR 0017 and ADR 0018).

dir.description:
The folder of the review roles, from the root of the project, when it is not
`.github/review` or `.gitlab/review`.

generated.description:
Globs of generated files, which the size of a change does not count. They cannot match a
path of `critical` or `platform`.

roles.description: The roles that CI expects. Default: the seven roles.

RuleConfig.description: Settings of one rule. Any other key is an option declared by that rule.

ignores.description: Replaces the default `ignores` of the rule (`[]` clears them).

Tier.description: How much review a change needs (ADR 0018).
